description.text:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Data Management Contractor to join our team. This role is ideal for someone with strong data management and Excel skills who enjoys working with large datasets and ensuring data accuracy. You will play a key role in data consolidation, cleansing, standardization, and preparation to support business reporting and system integration initiatives.
• Duties and Tasks:
o Consolidate data from multiple sources and formats.
o Clean, validate, and standardize large datasets to ensure data quality and consistency.
o Develop and maintain standardized data templates and formatting guidelines.
o Prepare datasets for system import and reporting purposes.
o Support Power BI reporting initiatives by providing structured and reliable data sources.
o Identify data quality issues and work with stakeholders to resolve inconsistencies.
o Document data structures, business rules, and operational procedures.
o Continuously improve data processing efficiency and standardization practices.
• Required Skills:
o Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including:
 Pivot Tables
 XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP
 INDEX/MATCH
 Power Query
 Data Validation
 Conditional Formatting
o Experience handling and organizing large datasets.
o Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
o Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
o Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
o Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Preferred Skills:
o Experience with Power BI.
o Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts.
o Experience in data cleansing, data governance, or master data management.
o Familiarity with process documentation and workflow standardization.
o Experience supporting reporting or business intelligence projects.
